description: A shell script for analyzing API changes between revisions in a Kubernetes repository, using the apidiff tool, and optionally building downstream projects to assess impact.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Outputs a revision and its descriptive tag if available.

methods.name: output_name
methods.description: Generates a sanitized filename for output based on a directory name.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Runs apidiff on each target directory and stores results.

methods.name: inWorktree
methods.description: Checks out a specific git revision into a worktree and executes a command there.

methods.name: inTarget
methods.description: Runs a command in the target revision of the repository, checking out if necessary.

methods.name: compare
methods.description: Compares API states between two revisions and reports differences and incompatibilities.

methods.name: tryBuild
methods.description: Attempts to build a project with replaced staging dependencies to test compatibility.
